summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with PositionField but may introduce regressions or functional incompleteness.

issues.description: The patch removes the check for `hasattr(obj.model, item)`, which might break other valid use cases where the attribute exists on the model but is not a field.
The patch does not handle all edge cases, such as when `getattr(obj.model, item)` raises an exception other than AttributeError.
